[RUN] cat work/scrape_upwork.py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import os, sys, json, requests
URL = "https://www.upwork.com/api/v3/jobs/search"
params = {"category_id": "1", "keyword": "n8n"}
api_key = os.getenv("UPWORK_API_KEY")
if not api_key:
    print("Missing UPWORK_API_KEY")
    sys.exit(1)
r = requests.get(URL, params=params, headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}"})
open("data/market_research/requirements.md", "w").write(json.dumps(r.json(), indent=2))
